title: Prescribed-qbot local Newton-trajectory attribution
question: Where along the analytical prescribed-qbot Newton trajectory does the derivative-consistent retention/capacity representation create the solver-facing discrepancy that causes one extra nonlinear iteration?
instrumentation: record per-iteration pressure head vectors evaluated by analytical and candidate providers
record theta and C from both providers at identical sampled heads
record storage Jacobian contribution C*dz/dt per node
record residual and tridiagonal main-diagonal differences before the nonlinear update when available without changing solver policy
record min/max head envelope actually visited by the accepted analytical trajectory
analysis_rule: Attribute the path shift only to a bounded head/node region if the dominant theta/C or storage-Jacobian discrepancy is concentrated there on the visited analytical trajectory. Do not infer a repair envelope from endpoint error alone.
prospective_repair_candidates_after_attr: exact authoritative theta/C inside a trajectory-justified head envelope and derivative-consistent interpolation outside
a different local interpolant family inside the identified envelope
